headline: The league's two best quarterbacks this week both played from the bench. Both their managers won anyway, so nobody learns a thing.
dek: Waddle Deez Nutz benches its Waddle for a sixth straight week. Correctly, this time.

matchups.2-5: Amie got 30-plus from Kenneth Walker III, CeeDee Lamb and Matthew Golden and still lost by 15.7, to a team that left five C.J. Stroud touchdowns on its bench. She never even saw the scariest part of that roster.
matchups.4-6: The closest game of the week, decided by 8.66. Brock Purdy threw two touchdowns and ran in a third for Tara, which is usually plenty. Kyra's kicker, Cam Little, scored 17, more than any of her three running backs. At 8-1, even the kicker gets a turn.
matchups.1-3: Marlee won by 14.7 after losing Josh Jacobs to a broken finger in the first quarter. Maddie's Patriots D/ST (the team-defense slot) allowed 45 points and finished at −5.
matchups.7-8: Samantha won by 21.52, the biggest margin of the week, and the headline already covered where her quarterback was. Cambri got 14 catches and 35 points from Puka Nacua, a performance that deserved a better Sunday than this one.

game_balls.title: Fresh off the wire
game_balls.text: Maya picked up Jonah Coleman and Ka'imi Fairbairn this week and started both. Coleman scored 18.8 in the flex (the wild-card spot), Fairbairn scored 17, and Maya posted the league high. The new guys didn't even need orientation.

game_balls.title: The gut has a waitlist
game_balls.text: Kyra started Joe Burrow over Matthew Stafford again. Burrow threw three touchdowns and ran in a fourth, Stafford scored 11.22 on her bench, and she won the closest game of the week by 8.66. Start Stafford and she loses.

game_balls.title: The receivers covered the spread
game_balls.text: Ja'Marr Chase scored 31.5, Christian Watson caught seven passes for 171 yards and a touchdown, and Samantha won by 21.52. Spread covered.

flags.title: Kelce, benched again
flags.text: Travis Kelce scored 17.3 on Cambri's bench, with a rushing touchdown, while Tucker Kraft caught one pass for one yard as her starting tight end. In Week 2 she benched Kelce and he scored 25.1. He has now made his point twice.

tough_breaks.title: Josh Jacobs, broken finger
tough_breaks.text: Josh Jacobs broke a finger in the first quarter and is having surgery this week, and reports say he could miss up to three weeks; here's to a quick recovery.

tough_breaks.title: Three 30-point games, one loss
tough_breaks.text: Kenneth Walker III scored a hat trick, and Amie still lost. Even her best possible lineup, 163.28, loses to Maya's 175.08. In Week 2 she lost to Maya's league high too. Some rivalries are just the schedule's fault.

glossary.definition: The player who kicks field goals and extra points, scoring more for longer kicks; most weeks nobody notices him, but Cam Little scored 17 for Kyra, so consider him noticed.

How much the other team scores and gains against your D/ST (your whole team defense, counted as one player), and in this league giving up a lot of either costs you, as the Patriots D/ST found out for Maddie: 45 points and 478 yards allowed, −5 total.
Betting slang for winning by more than the experts expected, and Samantha's projected edge over Cambri was tiny before she won by 21.52.
Three touchdowns by one player in one game, like Kenneth Walker III's two receiving and one rushing for Amie this week.
